::: {.store-lede}
Every NFL game of the season with date, kickoff time, teams, final score, overtime, rest days, stadium, roof, surface, weather, starting quarterbacks, head coaches and referee. Regular season and playoffs are in the same file, told apart by season_type and game_type; the preseason is not included. For the season in progress the file also lists games not yet played, with scores blank; playoff games appear once the matchups are set.
:::

## Columns

One row per game. 35 columns. A row is identified by `game_id`.

```{=html}
<div class="store-dict"><table class="table">
<thead><tr>
<th>Column</th>
<th>Type</th>
<th>What it holds</th>
</tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>game_id</td><td>string</td><td>nflverse game id: season, week, away team and home team (2023_01_DET_KC); joins every NFL file.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season</td><td>int</td><td>NFL season, named for the year it starts (the 2023 season ends with the February 2024 Super Bowl).</td></tr>
<tr><td>season_type</td><td>string</td><td>REG for the regular season, POST for the playoffs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_type</td><td>string</td><td>Round of the season: REG (regular season), WC (wild card), DIV (divisional), CON (conference championship), SB (Super Bowl).</td></tr>
<tr><td>week</td><td>int</td><td>Week of the season; playoff weeks continue the count after the last regular-season week.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_date</td><td>date</td><td>Date of the game in US Eastern time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>weekday</td><td>string</td><td>Day of the week the game is played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>kickoff_time_et</td><td>string</td><td>Scheduled kickoff, US Eastern time, 24-hour HH:MM.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_team</td><td>string</td><td>Away team abbreviation; one code per franchise in every season (LV, LAC and LA also cover the Oakland, San Diego and St. Louis years).</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_team</td><td>string</td><td>Home team abbreviation; one code per franchise in every season (LV, LAC and LA also cover the Oakland, San Diego and St. Louis years).</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_score</td><td>int</td><td>Final points for the away team, overtime included; blank until the game is played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_score</td><td>int</td><td>Final points for the home team, overtime included; blank until the game is played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_margin</td><td>int</td><td>Home score minus away score; negative when the away team won, blank until the game is played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>total_points</td><td>int</td><td>Home score plus away score; blank until the game is played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>overtime</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the game went to overtime; blank until the game is played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>neutral_site</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the game is played at a neutral site (international games, the Super Bowl), where the home team is the designated one.</td></tr>
<tr><td>division_game</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the two teams are in the same division.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_rest_days</td><td>int</td><td>Days since the away team&#x27;s previous game; 7 for a season opener.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_rest_days</td><td>int</td><td>Days since the home team&#x27;s previous game; 7 for a season opener.</td></tr>
<tr><td>roof</td><td>string</td><td>Stadium roof: outdoors, dome, or closed / open for a retractable roof.</td></tr>
<tr><td>surface</td><td>string</td><td>Playing surface, such as grass or fieldturf; can be blank for recent games until nflverse fills it in.</td></tr>
<tr><td>temperature_f</td><td>int</td><td>Temperature at kickoff in degrees Fahrenheit; blank for domes, closed roofs and games not yet played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>wind_mph</td><td>int</td><td>Wind speed at kickoff in miles per hour; blank for domes, closed roofs and games not yet played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_qb_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id (NFL GSIS id) of the away team&#x27;s starting quarterback; blank until the game is played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_qb_name</td><td>string</td><td>Name of the away team&#x27;s starting quarterback; blank until the game is played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_qb_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id (NFL GSIS id) of the home team&#x27;s starting quarterback; blank until the game is played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_qb_name</td><td>string</td><td>Name of the home team&#x27;s starting quarterback; blank until the game is played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_coach</td><td>string</td><td>Head coach of the away team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_coach</td><td>string</td><td>Head coach of the home team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>referee</td><td>string</td><td>Referee of the game; blank until the crew is recorded.</td></tr>
<tr><td>stadium_id</td><td>string</td><td>Stadium id used by Pro Football Reference.</td></tr>
<tr><td>stadium</td><td>string</td><td>Stadium name.</td></tr>
<tr><td>nfl_game_id</td><td>string</td><td>The NFL&#x27;s own ten-digit id for the game.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pfr_game_id</td><td>string</td><td>Pro Football Reference id for the game.</td></tr>
<tr><td>espn_game_id</td><td>string</td><td>ESPN id for the game.</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
```

## Source and method

Source: nflverse (github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data), released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license, CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0): play-by-play from nflfastR, games and schedules as maintained by Lee Sharpe. Changes: columns were selected and renamed, a few repeated plays removed, and the game logs added up from the play-by-play.

The same file layout, IDs and column names are used for every season, so seasons stack without cleanup. See [how the store works](help.qmd) for formats, delivery and the license.

## More NFL data

[Player Game Logs](nfl-player-logs.qmd) · [Team Game Logs](nfl-team-logs.qmd) · [Play-by-Play](nfl-play-by-play.qmd) · [All NFL data](nfl.qmd)

::: {.faq-item}
### How do the NFL files join to each other?

On the ID columns. Game, team and player IDs are the same strings in every NFL file and every season, so a join on `game_id` (plus `team` or `player_id` where the grain needs it) lines them up.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Which games are included?

Every regular-season and playoff game, built from the open nflverse play-by-play. Regular season and postseason sit in the same file, told apart by `season_type`. Preseason and All-Star games are left out.
:::
